info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Create Mortgage Loans Apply-v4-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loan Application Submission API facilitates the batch processing of mortgage loan applications. This endpoint allows financial institutions and their partners to submit multiple loan applications efficiently, ensuring streamlined workflows and improved response times. By utilizing this API, users can enhance their application processing capabilities, catering to various consumer needs including home purchases and refinancing. Typical consumers of this API include mortgage lenders, brokers, and financial service platforms seeking to optimize their loan application operations.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a loan application for processing. Ensure all required information is provided to facilitate the loan approval process.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a loan application. The client must provide all necessary details in JSON format, adhering to the specified schema to ensure a successful application process.
